g.text: Four low-side saturated BENCH channels. <=250mA/channel; <=1A combined injector current.

g.desc: Four low-side saturated BENCH channels. <=250mA/channel; <=1A combined injector current.

g.text: Do not connect low-impedance Evo injectors, fuel, real coils or an OEM harness.

g.desc: Do not connect low-impedance Evo injectors, fuel, real coils or an OEM harness.

g.text: 0.22ohm shunts have filtered ADC taps and paired Kelvin test pads. No fast short-circuit shutdown.

g.desc: 0.22ohm shunts have filtered ADC taps and paired Kelvin test pads. No fast short-circuit shutdown.

g.text: SS34 recirculation is deliberately slow; flyback energy and closing time are NOT suitable engine evidence.

g.desc: SS34 recirculation is deliberately slow; flyback energy and closing time are NOT suitable engine evidence.

g.text: Use47ohm >=10W resistor loads first. Optional enclosed dummy inductors <=10mH, <=250mA only after review.

g.desc: Use47ohm >=10W resistor loads first. Optional enclosed dummy inductors <=10mH, <=250mA only after review.
